description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of the “Darija Open Dataset” (Version 2) across six categories, as indicated by the legend on the right. There are 6 slices: “Translated Sentences” (olive/yellow-green) labeled 45,387 (roughly about one-third of the ring), “Pending Translations” (green) labeled 43,000 (also about one-third), “Extra + Augmented Data” (blue-gray) labeled 30,000 (about one-fifth to one-quarter), “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” (brown) labeled 23,108 (around one-sixth), plus two very thin slivers near the top for “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” (purple) and “Moroccan Names” (reddish-brown), whose values are not visibly labeled and appear to contribute only a small fraction each. Numeric labels are shown inside several larger slices (as counts rather than percentages), a legend maps colors to labels, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
